name: evowerk-cloud-mrp
description: Root task runner, same commands as the Makefile, works without make (plain Windows). No dependencies of its own.

scripts.setup: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.lock.txt && cd ../frontend && npm ci
scripts.test: cd backend && python -m pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm test
scripts.lint: cd backend && python -m ruff check . && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && docker compose build
